FINPLAN-TUI TOUR
This playground is a completely synthetic financial life.
It is safe to explore and does not connect to a bank or broker.
TRY THIS PATH
1 Dashboard — watch the live activity feed and balances
2 Tax lots — compare appreciated-stock gift targets
3 Locations — inspect a core-backed tax ranking
4 Cashflow — review categories and net cash flow
5 Recurring — wait for repeated synthetic merchants
6 Retirement — inspect the taxable portfolio bridge
DEMO MODES
--demo live synthetic stream; one virtual day per five seconds
--static-demo frozen fixture for screenshots and tests
The calculations are review aids, not tax, legal, investment, or
accounting advice. Press Escape to return.
